  PROBLEM: The later unconditional sweep can reattempt deletion of the same ended Routine denied in step 2; the regression test asserts that step 0 remains unconditional.
  WHY: This moves the retry to a later step instead of preventing it, contrary to §26.I.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "No protected path is touched, so no twin sync is needed" (PR description, "Also in this PR" section).
  Expected change site: PR description body, the "Also in this PR" section, and the `## Auto-decisions` AD-11 entry in `docs/implement-plan/issue-5068-skip-denied-cleanup-calls.md`.
  Evidence of absence: The PR DIFF modifies both `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` (root, lines 17-23, 139-145, 419-425) and `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` (the protected twin, same three hunks). `docs/implement-plan/issue-5068-skip-denied-cleanup-calls.md:54` records AD-12 with "Fix it in the twin despite AD-11? — Picked: A — yes" and a "Ninth sync, the twin only" blocker. The description's claim is therefore false, and AD-11's "Applied in: the conformance 1/3 fix PR" line hides the fact that the implementation actually applied AD-12. The description's "Verified by" column credits only `test_claude_md_26i_covers_the_per_stage_delete_and_rename`, and the "Checks run" line states "Before the fix: 722 passed, 1 skipped. After: 723 passed, 1 skipped" (a +1 delta).
